method: Direct read-only Review Agent skill; no delegation
scope: Complete F-27 diff, shared socket/provider callers, canonical read routes and regression tests

corrected_findings.title: Preserve unavailable status for degraded supported providers
corrected_findings.scenario: Capability readiness falls from ready to unavailable. Treating every disabled capability as unsupported loses the distinction between a temporary outage and an absent feature.
corrected_findings.resolution: Classify present degraded providers as unavailable; missing/disabled providers remain unsupported. Regression covers degradation and recovery.

corrected_findings.title: Clear cached snapshots when the provider becomes unsupported
corrected_findings.scenario: A provider returns HTTP 501 after a successful read. Unsupported status previously retained cached records because the HTTP failure did not set clear.
corrected_findings.resolution: Unsupported failures always clear cached data. Regression covers success followed by 501.

corrected_findings.title: Track audio sequences before declaring a chat gap
corrected_findings.scenario: Delivered audio advances the canonical conversation sequence. Ignoring those frames makes the next chat event trigger a false gap and clear selected inspection.
corrected_findings.resolution: Event and audio frames share the reconciliation cursor; only chat events select domain invalidations. Regression tests demonstrate red-to-green snapshot retention, real audio-exposed gaps, per-conversation isolation and duplicate/reordered frames. Corrective diff rechecked against the canonical producer and shared observer; no further findings.

residual_risks: No certification of future full-stack merge or production activation
Eventual snapshot convergence, not exactly-once event delivery
